$description: Proposed R15 motion tokens (Codex DESIGN-SYSTEM-REVIEW, 2 November 2026). Working values, not measured or owner-approved. Interactive UI uses them; films may use longer movements. prefers-reduced-motion: finished content visible at once, no parallax, no ongoing movement.

transitions.shared-object: Keep one parented anchor from source to destination; use a path morph or mask when the topology differs. No one-frame flash at the seam.
transitions.colour-field: Move a clipped plane across the existing ground; no repeated full-width diagonal wipe. The ground settles fully and keeps tested text contrast.
transitions.card-clip: Moving cards are clipped by their frame; no visible artificial entry line.
transitions.os-motion: The selected stencil is the mask; the slash marks a decision and can carry into the next seam. Solid build below 48px; never re-typeset the wordmark.
